tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba sa lo chen po'i gsung la sngags 'chang chen pos mchan gnang ba dkyus mchan lhan cig bsdeb cing a mes zhabs kyi gsung nas kyang cung zad kha bskangs ba bzhugs so/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha ya na ma mya haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las drag po'i sku/ /rdo rje gsum gyi zhal ldan pha rol phyin/ /phyag gi yal gas rab brjid dbang sngon mdangs/ /khro bo'i dbang po mchog la gus btud nas/ /de nyid sgrub thabs 'khrul med brgyud pa'i gsung / /zhal gyi bdud rtsi las rnyed bsnyen sgrub tshul/ /gsal bar ston pa'i man ngag 'dir bshad kyi/ /don gnyer shes ldan gus pa'i tshul gyis nyon/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i lugs su grags pa 'di la/ rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud kyi le'u'i lag zur du phyung ba/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chung 'di nyid la brten nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin/ rje btsun rin chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi thob yig mdzad pa gzhir bzhag nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sgrub thabs che 'bring chung ngu gsum mdzad pa las rgyun du nyams su len pa dang / dus dang / grangs kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe/ sgrub thabs chung ba 'di nyid don tshang la nyams su len bde bas de'i tshul dkyus su mi gsal ba cung zad brjod na/ thog mar gong du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sgrub khang bla ma gong ma yid ches pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin pa'am/ yang na 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin pa'i sar/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang / khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du/

'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb skyus bskor ba la/ ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yon du bhan+dha lcang lo can gyi nang du rak+ta/ khrag ma 'byor na chang la sha dmar po btab pa/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman phud gtsang ma/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas sbreng tshar du bshams/ rang nyid shar ram lhor kha phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ oṃ badz+ra u tha pa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bid pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pa ra mi tā/ nā da swa bha we na badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ ḍā dril dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod/ nam mkhar bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams mngon sum ltar bzhugs par mos nas skyabs 'gro'i khyad par bzhi gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro'i yul bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku dge 'dun/

gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam/ skyabs su 'gro ba pha ma rigs drug gis skyabs 'gro byed par bsam/ rgyu 'jigs dad snying rje gsum/ dus sangs rgyas ma thob bar ro/ /ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgos pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /lan cig sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /tshar cig oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐/ badz+ra ban+dha badz+ra añdza li dza/ yab yum sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu brdungs la/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /songs shig lha min lha yang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /oṃ badz+ra kī la kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃbadz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs khar thim/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung / sna bug nas thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ sems kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug tho rnams spros nas 'og tu de dag gi sa gzhi/ logs su rwa ba steng du gur la sogs par gyur par bsam ste/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung sbrel mthe bos srin mdzub mnan/ gung mdzub gnyis gyen du sbrel ba'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor zhing bgegs bskrad/

phyag rgya g.yas su bskor bas rwa gur du gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ gong gi badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa/ tshar gnyis brjod pa'i rting ma la phaṭa bzhag pa/ 'og ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar ba la mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /oṃ badz+ra te dza tiṣ+ṭha tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan bsnol mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang / rwa ba de rnams las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs/ phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas/ /bdud phung nges par sreg byed pa/ /sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yis/ /'bar ba me yi phung por gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐/ mtshams bcad cing bsrung 'khor bsgoms pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsrung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra kī li kī la ya maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā re bh+yeḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /tshar gsum/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying gar thim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang / byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas/

byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de'i dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pas mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad yab yum mnyam par sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa 'od kyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas byung bas rang dang gnas la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pas mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus te dag par byas/ bh+rūṃ spros pas bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me yi steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyid pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par/ hūm̐ oṃ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥha las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka/ oṃ dzi na dz-ig swa rarna dhṛka/ āḥ.a ro l̥ka/ hā pradzñā dhṛka/ ces brjod pas/ he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ sbyor ba'i me 'od du zhu oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas bstim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing dung phor 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang /

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang rgyun du gsum te gzhong pa 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba lin+ta ba la bā te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rgyun du gsum ste/ rak+ṣa'i snod a las thod pa yangs par raṃ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ maṃ sur+ya maṇ+ḍal ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ paṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ pad+ma 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥthāḥ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs so/ /yaṃ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod pas/ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par gyur par bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyun du sman raka gtor gsum dang bsnyen phur ma bshams kyang bsams nas byin rlabs rung ba 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gdong dga' ba'i dris lan na yod/ dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i phyir snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ༈ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi go ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/

/hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ mched snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e/ yaṃ/ baṃ/ raṃ/ laṃ/ raṃ/ keṃ/ e/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyed pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rak+ṣa'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ /dzaḥs pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de wī dza/ u ma de wī dza/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus te 'od du zhu ba/ rang rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/

/sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha bub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched/ skra nyi khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra ba go mtshams med pas bltams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /bh+rūṃ bi mā na ma sūr+ya hūm̐/ dzñā na sa twa kṛṣ+ṇa shu ka pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la brgyan/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyangs bskums kyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rjer bsgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇī hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bai ra bī hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ṇī hūm̐ hoḥ 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom mnyes byed kyi phyag rgya kyai rdor bzhin/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs su/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsams nas/ de dag 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'bru gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam la/

sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa/ /sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung / /rdo rje༞ /chos kyi༞ /'bar ba'i༞ /gsung gi gter༞ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /rdo rje༞ /chos kyi༞ /'bar ba'i༞ /thugs kyi gter du༞ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas khro bo rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bsam zhing / thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces brjod/ de nas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhi shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhi shwa ri traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥ de yan chad bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas phur gdan e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba bskyed/ sarba sha truṃ bigh+nān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod dus gru gsum gyi dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ brjod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi phur pa la gu gul gyis bdug cing /

yungs dkar gyis brab/ bsnyen pa la sogs dgos pa'i skabs su yungs dkar gu gul rnams kyi thum bu dang cod paṇa lnga brtsegs btags pa de go chod par mdzad/ khro bo'i drag po la ni rak+ti thum bu'ang 'dogs dgos snyam te/ sgrol dbang na 'di thams cad la rjes yod pas so/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig mched pa mdun du sras mchog zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa'i skur bsams la/ skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i lha/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /zhes pas chos sku las longs sku he ru kar bzhengs par bskul bas mkha' nas longs sku yab yum sprul par bsam ste/ phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /de nas longs sku las/ sprul sku sras mchog sprul par gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /badz+ra kī li kī lā ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas longs sku las sprul sku/ sras mchog sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug smad phur bu'i rnam pa can du bsam/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrīḥ rtse mor phaṭa/ ces pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bstim/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ sogs lngas gong bzhin dbang bskur/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal/ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ hūm̐ swā/

āḥ hā/ saṃ/ maṃ/ laṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐/ badz+ra ban+dha/ badz+ra añdza li dzaḥ phur pa chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas bzung nas/ dīp+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dabs 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñtsa/ spyi gtsug oṃ dip+ta tsakra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsakra a bhi ṣīñtsa/ dpral ba/ oṃ dip+ta rat+na kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rat+na a bhi ṣīñtsa/ rna ltag g.yas/ oṃ dip+ta pad+ma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa/ ltag pa/ oṃ dīp+ta karma kī li kī lā ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ karma a bhi ṣīñtsa/ rna ltag g.yon/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya a bhi ṣīñtsa oṃ/ dpral ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ mgrin pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ snying ga nas de rnams su reg pas/ khro bo khro mo thams cad kyi phrin las bdag la 'dus par bsam mo/ /bsnyen phur ma bshams pa'i skabs gong gi phyag rgya de gnas de rnams su gtugs pas go chod par mdzad/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/

/kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang dag don du dag mod kyang / /'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pā ri wā ra hasta tsa pā d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas zhabs bsil gdan phul/ bde bar gshegs so khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /ḍā dril dang bcas pas/ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ badz+ra gīr ti hriḥ badz+ra nīrti āḥ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hriḥ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rnams kyi phyi mchod dang / nang mchod mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can kun bsgral phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/

/bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrīḥka pā la/ ban+dha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro bo yab yum bcu/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang / /sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/ /rnam dag sogs/ ༞༞ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang / /dpag bsam shing lnga re ma tī rnams la/ /rnam dag ༞ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang / /bse'i lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag ༞ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi༞ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i༞ longs sku rdo rje sems pa'i༞ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang gi lce dang gnas gsum du nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /ka ya sid+dhi oṃḥ wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ gsang mchod ni/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /pad+mo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par byos/ /sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rā go a nu rā ga ya mi bo dhi tsit+ta/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ste/

/bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung nas bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad la/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra a we sha ya a we sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ma hā su kha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ pra ti gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ gsang mchod dang de kho na'i mchod pa/ 'di gnyis la phyag rgya med/ bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo khro mo phra thabs sgo ma/ sras mchog dam can gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bsgral bar bsam zhing / rdor dril gsor dkrol gyis/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la༞ /pho nya chen po'i dus la༞ /bdag nyid chen po'i dus༞ /sa bdag rgyal mo'i༞ /khyi yi gdong can༞ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni de bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /oṃ laṃ/ hūm̐ laṃ/ satwaṃ bha ni mo haṃ ghā ta ya bha ga wān hrī ṣ+ṭīḥ bi kri badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+nān badz+ra kī li kī la ya phaṭa/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus kyis mchod par bsams la/ ḍā dril/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/

/mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā sa ma ya rak+ta sa mu dra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hṛ ta da ya pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar gyi mchod pa rgya mtshor bskyil/ /'khor ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra man tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā ru dhi ra khā hi/ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā ma ta ka khā hi/ ma hā as+d+yi khā hi/ de thams cad gtor ma'i steng du rak+ṣa bsgrengs/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ bha lin+ta pra tīts+tsha ho/ gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sngags 'di gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang dril bu gsil/ rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /gar dgu'i rol mdzad rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /e ka dza ṭī gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang smig bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang kha ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo

/'khyil pa sgra mdzad seng ge pha waṃ mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dom dang dred mong mgo /stobs chen rig byed dom dang byi ba'i mgo /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dngos grub mchog stsol ye shes chen mo'i dngos/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can tshogs/ /phrin las bzhi bsgrub dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /rigs lnga khro bcu sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la bstod/ /'jam mchod ni/ bzlas pa'i skabs su/ hūm̐ badz+ra dzña na kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod dus/ rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ de dang 'dra ba yum med gcig mdun du bye nas rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs/ dzña na satwa e tri kho ṇa bi ma na/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa/ brjod dus/ rang gi snying gar gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar kī la ya'i sngags kha dog sngon po skra shad kyis bris pa lta bu g.yas bskor du bsams nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor gyi phra man pho nya'i tshogs la sogs/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha/ /drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba lcags sgrogs sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas byung /

ye shes sems dpa' dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon/ mdun gyi sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung mdun gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ rang dang ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas song / rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags phreng phyir 'gro dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byon nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe gong du bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu sogs kyis spyan drangs pas/ mdun gyi bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang / sems can yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam zhing / sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la sems gtad pa ni man ngag dam pa yin pas 'di'i ngang nas kī la ya kho nar grangs bzung / gzhan yang dmigs pa'i rnams grangs rnams rnam bshad chen mo na yod do// bzlas 'phro 'jog pa na/ oṃ dīp+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci rigs pa dang / ma rak+mo/ yak+mo/ kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la khril khril/ srog la chum chum/ tsit+ta srog la tum tum/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shan/ snying tshag tshag 'ur 'ur/ shig shig gul gul/ nyag nyag sod sod/ dha ti/ ma ma shī gh+raṃ/ karma ka ra mā ra se na/ pra mar+dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog pa byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la phreng ba spyi bor reg mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas sgeg phreng sogs kyi sngags la ḍā dril bcas phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā ban+dha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nang mchod phul nas/ rdo rjes phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang dril bu gsil la/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi bzad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yak+ṣa he ru ka/ /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / 'di ni bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar yin la gtor bsngo'i bdag bskyed sogs rgyun pa ltar na/ bde bar gshegs pa nas tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi rjes su mdun gyi nas ldan par gyur bar/ lha tshogs stsol bar brjod la gtor bsngo sogs la 'jug go /lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba dang / /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /de nas gur zhal sogs chos skyong la gtor ma sngar nas 'bul bzhin pa yin na 'dir 'bul/ yang na thun dang po rnams la/ dkar bdud dam can rnams la 'bul ba tsam gyis chog pas/

de dag gi gtor ma dkar mo ba la zlum gtor dkar po/ bdud rgyal phur srung la dmar gtor gru gsum re bshams la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pa gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ sogs nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas bstim// bar gong bzhin/ 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro sogs nas/ gyur bar yang gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du bh+yoḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ri rab bsgongs rdor 'phen cing / g.yon pas gling bzhi byo ldog tu mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan cing / nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs gyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la phyar zhing / g.yon pas rus phreng phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil/ bh+yoḥ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs/

/thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badz+ra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye mthar se gol dang / oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma kun+tiṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la la mā la dha ra sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shan+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ ba shaṃ ku ru/ dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ zhes pas nang mchod phul nas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa/ phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas/ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shri gh+raṃ karma ka ra mā ra se na pra mar dha ni sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yang sa pā ri wā ra/ yan gyi yan/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhūñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam lnga yis gtor ma phul la nang mchod gtor zhing / oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi༞ sogs phrin las gong bzhin bcol la/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang dril bu gsil/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs de bzhin du/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang / /dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba dang / /sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /bsam pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ sngon tshe bdud kun gyi ni bdag po che/ /shin tu mi bzad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi /spyan sngar dam bcas bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod/ /hūm̐ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/

/dam can ma mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis/ /rnam lnga rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma sring mdza' mo'i tshul gyis grogs mdzod cig /thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /thun tha ma'i mjug tu yi dam kyai rdor sogs dang lhan cig gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma byin brlabs kyai rdor bzhin byas pas chog gi gzhan byin rlabs zur du mi dgos/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam bzhin du bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang / sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs nas rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs med pa la gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya zhing / oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā wa tse hūm̐ phaṭa/ lus bsrung zhing go cha bgo dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /sogs kyis bsngo ba dang / skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /sogs kyis bkra shis rnams skabs dang sbyor la bya'o/ /thun tha ma la srung ma rnams kyi gtor ma phul rjes bstod pa byas la mgyogs gtor phul nas/ ye shes lnga ldan man chad bya zhing / dus rgyun du bsnyen pa byed tshul 'di tsam gyis chog la skabs su dus bzang ba rnams dang / bsnyen pa thon rjes tshogs bsdus pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha/ sogs dang / rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pas me'i tshogs kyis snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/

zhes sogs kyis sman dang gtor mar byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin las/ 'og gi tshogs dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs shing tshogs 'bul ba'i tshig ni/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa la/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa pā ri wā ra tri sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pas tshim par byed/ /ro yi mchod pas bde mchog ldan/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bla na med/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka/ i daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ghan+dhaṃ/ ba liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho/ gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod/ bshags pa ni/ lus kyis sdig pa bgyis pa mngon sum du/ /ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod/ /sems kyis blo nor log par bsam pa sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / /de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i dam can rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsam na brlag par mdzad/ /chags nyams 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ /mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phyag len la mtshams 'dir spyi bstabs dang bstan skyong mdzad pas/

bstan skyong ni/ hoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dpal chen po'i pham 'bab la/ mnos te rnal 'byor pa'i stong dang grogs la/ nag mo bzhin mi sdug pa'i bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang / dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi dang / dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi rnams sngon kyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni hūm̐ dzaḥ.e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ bh+yoḥ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs bstan ma skyong ba rnams/ /'dir byon dam dgongs phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bdud mo chen mo mched bzhi dang / /kha rag khyung btsun la sogs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen mo mched bzhi dang / /sman btsun chen mo mched bzhi rnams/ /bran g.yogs mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /bar chad rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ tshogs kyi lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ lhag ma za ba'i bye brag pho nya phra men ma/ 'bar ma/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun/ sring bzhi sogs pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos bkug la mchod par bsam zhing / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dpag yas las/ /grub pa gsang ba 'bar ma'i tshogs/ /tshur gshegs gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rdo rje lcam dral bsrung ba dang / /rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ bsgrengs/ de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis phyir nur la/ dpal gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs shing mchod par bya ste/ dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum gyi/

/pho nya 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /de yi bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcu dag nas gshegs su gsol/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phra men tshogs dang bcas/ /'bar ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki ni pra tits+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ma liṃ traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrī/ oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥ zhes pas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma byin/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭha ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma la kha chus btab la/ bsngo ba ni/ khro rgyal dpal gyi pho nya mo/ /ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi/ /dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī/ /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs shig /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /sarba a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni stod las byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med la/ smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang du byas na kī la ya la yi ge srog can bcu drug yod pas 'bru bcu gsum gyi 'bum phrag bcu drug de'i kha skong khri tsho bcu drug stong phrag bcu drug rnams bzlas nas bsnyen pa'i mthar kha skong gi sbyin sreg ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg spyi dang mthun zhing / grangs ni rdzas ril lam/ yungs dkar gang rung dang sngags ki la ya kho na la grangs bzung nas skabs su sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes spel tshig can ci rigs bya/ bsnyen pa'i dus kyang kī la ya kho na la sngags kyi grangs bzung bas chog go
